headline: Values Wheel, from entry to detail
overview:
The Values Wheel helps you discover, rate, and track your core values over time. You define up to 8 values that matter most to you — like Family, Health, Career Growth, Creativity — then rate each on a 0-10 alignment scale reflecting how well you're currently living that value.

The result is a beautiful color-coded radar wheel that instantly reveals where you're thriving and where gaps exist. Each value can have reflection notes and action tasks attached, turning abstract ideals into concrete commitments.

Additional features include AI-powered value discovery, AI check-in suggestions based on your activity, a relationship comparison module (invite contacts to compare values), and a reflection prompt to deepen your understanding. You can create multiple wheels over time to track how your priorities shift.
targetAudience: Anyone seeking clarity on what truly matters to them and how well their daily life reflects those priorities. Whether you're making a major life decision, feeling misaligned, or simply want a framework for intentional living — the Values Wheel gives you a visual compass for your priorities.

steps.title: Landing Page — Your Values Wheel
steps.description:
Navigate to /values-wheel to see the Values Wheel page. The page displays:

- **VALUES WHEEL** heading with 'Discover and align with what matters most to you'
- **My Values** dropdown (for managing multiple wheels) showing the count (e.g., 7/8)
- An AI check-in banner: 'Time for a values check-in? Let AI review your recent activity and suggest score adjustments'
- Stats dashboard: Avg Score, Balance indicator, top value with score, Gaps Found
- **Values list** on the left with color-coded dots and scores
- **Wheel visualization** on the right with colored segments for each value
- **Discover Values** button for AI-guided discovery
- **Add a New Value** expandable section for manual entry

You can add values manually or let AI help you discover them through guided reflection.
steps.screenshotAlt: Values Wheel landing page showing 7 values listed with the colorful wheel visualization on the right, stats dashboard showing 5.0 average score and Balanced indicator

steps.title: Adding Values & The Wheel Takes Shape
steps.description:
As you add values (type a name and tap Add or press Enter), each one appears in the values list with a color-coded dot, a default score of 5/10, and an expand arrow. The wheel on the right fills in with colored segments — one per value.

With all 8 values added, you get a full wheel plus a stats header showing:
- **Avg Score** — your overall alignment (e.g., 5.0)
- **Balance** indicator — how evenly distributed your scores are
- **Top/Bottom Value** — which value is scoring highest or lowest
- **Gaps Found** — values significantly below your average

The wheel shows all 8 labeled segments (Family, Health, Career Growth, Creativity, Spirituality, Friendship, Adventure, Learning) in distinct colors.
steps.screenshotAlt: Values Wheel with 8 values added, all at score 5, with colorful wheel segments on the right showing Learning, Family, Health, Career Growth, Creativity, Spirituality, Friendship, Adventure

steps.title: Scoring & Reflecting on Each Value
steps.description:
Tap any value row to expand its detail panel. For each value you can:

- **Alignment Score** (0-10 slider) — drag from 'Not living it' to 'Fully aligned'. The wheel segment grows or shrinks in real time as you adjust
- **Reflection Notes** — write what this value means to you and how you're living it
- **Action Tasks** — add concrete next steps to better honor this value
- **Remove** — delete the value if it no longer resonates

As you adjust scores, the stats header updates instantly: average score, balance indicator, and gap detection all recalculate. The wheel visualization reflects the new proportions immediately. In the screenshot, Family is set to 8/10 and its segment on the wheel is visibly larger than the others.

steps.title: Relationships & Reflection
steps.description:
Below the values list and wheel, additional sections provide deeper engagement:

- **My Relationships** — invite contacts to create their own Values Wheel and compare alignment. See where your values overlap or diverge with people who matter to you. Shows 'Invite Your First Contact' for new users
- **Reflection Prompt** — an AI-generated question like 'Which value needs more attention in your life right now? What's one way you could honor it this week?' with a text area for journaling. Supports voice input (microphone) and image attachments
- **Image & Export** buttons at the top let you download the wheel as an image or export your data (PRO)

The Values Wheel is designed to be revisited regularly — create new wheels over time to track how your priorities evolve.

keyFeatures: Rate up to 8 core values on a 0-10 alignment scale
Beautiful color-coded radar wheel visualization that updates in real time
AI-powered value discovery through guided reflection
AI check-in suggestions based on your recent activity
Reflection notes and action tasks for each value
Stats dashboard: average score, balance indicator, gap detection
Relationship comparison — invite contacts to compare values alignment
Multiple wheels over time to track priority shifts
Voice input and image attachments for reflections
tips: Be honest with your scores — this tool works best when you rate how you're actually living, not how you wish you were
Aim for variety — pick values from different life areas (personal, professional, spiritual, social)
Use the Action Tasks field to turn low scores into concrete next steps
Revisit your wheel monthly to see how your alignment shifts
A 'gap' isn't bad — it highlights where your attention is needed most
Try the AI Discover feature if you're unsure what your core values are
Invite a partner or close friend to compare values — it sparks great conversations
The goal isn't all 10s — it's awareness of where you invest your energy
